import json
pkts=19999
events=[]
off=[0]*32

    events.append({"t":i,"op":"datagram","bytes":1200,"packets":[{"level":"A","pn":i,"auth":True,"frames":frs}]})

req={"version":1,"traces":[{"id":"big","config":cfg,"events":events}]}

print("size",len(open('big2.json').read()),"data",sum(off))
